card.name: Web address pieces and name labels
card.fires_on: Punctuation or short pieces inside web addresses, especially the ?v after youtube.com/watch, www, and .com. Also the colon after language-name labels and the 2 in Btu/ft2.

modes.label: URL parts
modes.description: Pieces within a web link, such as ?v in a YouTube link, www, or .com.

modes.label: Name label colon
modes.description: Colon after a language name in a list of plant names.

modes.label: Unit exponent
modes.description: The superscript 2 in a heat flux unit.

card.plain: It fires on small pieces inside web links and on punctuation in labeled lists, where the next piece is an arbitrary string.
